criteria.instant: does one thing right now and is finished, like a spell, a strike, or an action
criteria.lasting: puts an ongoing effect on an area or a unit that keeps working for several turns
criteria.summon: calls a person, creature, or machine to fight or work for the player
criteria.move: moves someone or something to another place

timing.instructions: When would the effect of an orb with this name happen?

criteria.trigger: only when something specific happens, like a trap or a reaction

range.instructions: How far would the effect of an orb with this name reach?

criteria.line: a line, a short path, or a few neighboring spots
criteria.around: a ring or blast area around one point

side.instructions: Who or what would an orb with this name mostly affect?

criteria.ally: the player and the player's helpers
criteria.land: the land, buildings, and resources on the map

persist.instructions: What happens to an orb with this name after it is used?

criteria.used_up: it is a one-time thing that gets used up
criteria.returns: it is a tool or ability that can be used again and again
criteria.stays: it stays on the map after use, like a building, a plant, or a trap
